service: US EPA ECHO Environmental Compliance & ESG Penalty Auditor
description: Audits industrial facilities across the United States via the official U.S. EPA ECHO REST API. Extracts Clean Air/Water/RCRA non-compliance quarters, Significant Non-Complier (SNC) flags, and federal penalties to calculate ESG liability scores (0-100).

inputSchema.title: US EPA ECHO Environmental Compliance & ESG Penalty Auditor Input
inputSchema.description: Configure US State, facility name, ZIP code, and Significant Non-Complier (SNC) filters to audit industrial environmental compliance via U.S. EPA ECHO.

state.title: US State Code (2-Letter)
state.description: 2-letter US State code where industrial facilities are located (e.g., 'TX', 'CA', 'LA', 'OH', 'PA').

facilityName.title: Facility or Company Name (Optional)
facilityName.description: Optional facility or operator name keyword (e.g., 'Refinery', 'Chemical', 'Plant', 'Energy').

zipCode.title: 5-Digit US ZIP Code (Optional)
zipCode.description: Optional 5-digit US postal code to narrow environmental due diligence (e.g., '77506', '77002').

significantViolatorsOnly.title: Significant Violators Only (SNC / HPV)
significantViolatorsOnly.description: Filter exclusively for facilities currently in Significant Non-Compliance (SNC) under CAA, CWA, or RCRA.

maxResults.title: Maximum Facilities to Audit
maxResults.description: Maximum number of EPA-regulated facilities to extract and score (1 to 200).

registryId.title: EPA Registry ID
registryId.description: Official U.S. EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS) identifier.

facilityName.title: Facility Name
facilityName.description: Regulated industrial plant or facility name.

city.title: City
city.description: City where the facility is located.

complianceStatus.title: EPA Compliance Status
complianceStatus.description: Current compliance status across Clean Air, Clean Water, and RCRA statutes.

sncFlag.title: Significant Non-Complier (SNC)
sncFlag.description: True if flagged as Significant Non-Complier or High Priority Violator.

quartersInNonCompliance.title: Quarters in Non-Compliance (3-Yr)
quartersInNonCompliance.description: Number of quarters (0 to 12) in non-compliance over the last 3 years.

totalPenaltiesUsd.title: Total Penalties (USD)
totalPenaltiesUsd.description: Cumulative formal enforcement monetary penalties assessed in USD.

environmentalLiabilityScore.title: Environmental Liability Score (0-100)
environmentalLiabilityScore.description: Quantitative ESG and environmental liability risk score (0-100).

inspectionCount5Yr.title: Inspections (5-Yr)
inspectionCount5Yr.description: Total federal and state regulatory inspections conducted.

markdownEsgDueDiligenceBrief.title: Markdown ESG & M&A Due Diligence Brief
markdownEsgDueDiligenceBrief.description: Executive environmental liability dossier for commercial real estate, M&A, and ESG risk teams.
